# Kav-UI assets

Kav-UI v0.0.3 from the GitHub release https://github.com/Kai17-a/Custom-UI/releases/tag/v0.0.3
(`kav-ui-v0.0.3.zip`, checked with `kav-ui-v0.0.3.zip.sha256`). This folder holds the zip's
`kav-ui/assets` contents and `VERSION`.

Do not edit these files. To update, download a newer release zip, verify it with
`sha256sum --check`, and replace the whole folder with its `kav-ui/assets` contents.
